title: The Last Rebel
description: Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.

title: The Thrill Hunter
description: After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.

title: Gunmen From Laredo
description: A framed Texas rancher escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloon keeper.

title: Trail of the Rustlers
description: A woman and her two sons plot to drive other ranchers from their land after they discover a secret water source.

title: Laramie Mountains
description: The Durango Kid learns that crooked scouts are behind attempts to escalate a war between a local tribe and the cavalry.

title: One Man Law
description: Settlers and a sheriff catch on to a Chicago swindler's land scam.

title: Land Raiders
description: An Arizona land-grabber (Telly Savalas) and his brother (George Maharis) renew their feud amid Army troops and Apaches.

title: Mackenna's Gold
description: Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.

title: The Longest Drive
description: Two brothers (Kurt Russell, Tim Matheson), one raised by Indians, seek their sister in the 1890s West.

title: Fury at Gunsight Pass
description: One bank robber (David Brian) double-crosses another (Neville Brand), giving the undertaker and others a chance at the loot.

title: Return of the Durango Kid
description: A stagecoach passenger poses as a masked avenger to track down the thieves who robbed him and his companions.

title: The Violent Men
description: A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.

title: Santa Fe
description: Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.

title: The California Trail
description: Cowboy Santa Fe Stewart (Buck Jones) fights a tyrant in Spanish California.

title: Count Three and Pray
description: A preacher (Van Heflin) with a reckless past rebuilds a church after the Civil War with a teenage girl (Joanne Woodward) from the hills.

title: Jack McCall, Desperado
description: During the Civil War, a Southerner joins the Union Army and is accused of leaking information to the Confederates.

title: A Lawless Street
description: The wife (Angela Lansbury) of a roving marshal (Randolph Scott) wants him to quit, but first he has to clean up Medicine Bend.

title: Comanche Station
description: Three outlaws join a loner (Randolph Scott) and another man's wife (Nancy Gates), who was kidnapped by Indians.

title: Riding Wild
description: A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.

title: The Return of Wild Bill
description: Wild Bill Saunders comes home to help his father deal with troublesome ranchers.

title: The Last Frontier
description: Three trappers become scouts for a cavalry captain (Guy Madison) who loses his fort to a hated colonel (Robert Preston).

title: Gunfighters
description: A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) turns cowhand and then back again, fighting a cattle baron with two daughters (Barbara Britton, Dorothy Hart).

title: Oklahoma Crude
description: A wildcatter (Faye Dunaway), her father (John Mills) and a boozing drifter (George C. Scott) defend her oil derrick in 1913 Oklahoma.

title: Stranger From Arizona
description: A quiet cowboy (Buck Jones) on a white horse saves a gal (Dorothy Fay) from cattle rustlers.

title: The Quick Gun
description: A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.

title: Apache Territory
description: A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.

title: The Great Sioux Massacre
description: The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

title: Ten Wanted Men
description: An Arizona rancher (Randolph Scott) protects his empire from a rival landowner (Richard Boone) and his hired guns.

title: Decision at Sundown
description: A gunman (Randolph Scott) rides into Sundown for a showdown with the big shot (John Carroll) he blames for stealing his wife.

title: 3:10 to Yuma
description: A rancher (Van Heflin) needing cash is hired to put an outlaw (Glenn Ford) on the train to Yuma prison.

title: The Big Gundown
description: Lawman John Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) searches the U.S.-Mexico border for a Mexican peasant (Tomas Milian) accused of raping and killing a 12-year-old girl.

title: Headin' East
description: A cowboy discards his chaps and saddle for a suit and tie when he travels to the big city to investigate a produce racket that has been ruining his father's lettuce shipments.

title: The Law vs. Billy the Kid
description: Outlaw Billy (Scott Brady) courts a rancher's daughter (Betta St. John) and is hunted by lawman Pat Garrett (James Griffith).

title: They Rode West
description: The new doctor (Robert Francis) at a cavalry fort finds resentment at first, even more once he treats Indians.

title: Dirty Little Billy
description: Farm boy Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) rebels in 1870s Kansas and goes on to become Billy the Kid.
